content.short: Kinetiq is a liquid staking protocol on Hyperliquid, issuing kHYPE against staked HYPE.
content.description: Kinetiq issues kHYPE, a liquid staking token for Hyperliquid that earns native staking rewards while staying usable across DeFi. Holders keep full liquidity and capital efficiency, since kHYPE is accepted around the Hyperliquid ecosystem as collateral and in pools. A separate iHYPE product serves institutional stakers with their own requirements.
